description.value: GitLab is a DevSecOps platform that positions itself as an intelligent orchestration layer for software delivery.
GitLab's company page describes it as the company behind the intelligent orchestration platform, whose AI agents help teams ship software.
GitLab is a software forge primarily developed by GitLab Inc.
GitLab is an AI-powered DevSecOps platform, sold to software teams.
GitLab is a DevSecOps software company whose business is built on subscriptions to a single platform.

product_description.value: Sells GitLab Duo Agent Platform (AI agents that turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities and review code), plus planning, source control and CI/CD, with scanning, policies and approvals built into the pipeline.
Products listed by name: GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Code Suggestions (AI), CI/CD, GitLab on AWS and GitLab on Google Cloud.
A single application covering the software development lifecycle, including version control, project management, security and compliance, and CI/CD.
A single application covering planning, source code management, CI/CD, security testing and release governance; recent AI additions include Duo Agent Platform and Duo Code Review.

business_model_description.value: Customers make an annual commitment and allocate spending across seats and usage credits; GitLab Flex combines seat-based licenses with usage-based credits.
Open-core model, offered as both self-managed and SaaS, plus related training and professional services.
Primarily subscription based, with SaaS, self-managed and dedicated deployment options plus a smaller services component.

customer_description.value: Named customers include NVIDIA, Barclays, Lockheed Martin, Thales, Ericsson, Deutsche Telekom, Agoda, Nasdaq, CACI, Deakin University and Jaguar Land Rover; serves financial services, public sector, telecom, automotive, education and aerospace.
Roughly half of the Fortune 100 are customers.

Serves organizations from large enterprises to technology-driven startups in finance, aerospace, automotive, technology and defense; named customers include Goldman Sachs, Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Nvidia and Siemens.
